original_test_intent: Exercise every front-side storage bay for 12 hours at 0C/-5% rails and detect device, data-path or platform instability.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Select front-side disks in SST and stress for 12 hours under cold undervoltage.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: The source repeats procedure steps rather than defining a technical pass condition.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED MANUAL ONLY with strict storage interlocks; included 12 hours versus 240-minute Machine Time as SOURCE_CONFLICT.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator controls cold chamber and rails; storage I/O can begin only after signed target checks.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 0C/-5% rails, all front-side bays, 12-hour SST stress; 240-minute Machine Time is planning metadata.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Bay manifest, persistent target identities, ownership/protection checks, safe workload/range, integrity/acceptance and environmental limits.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Any excluded bay, shortened run or different I/O profile is a declared project difference.

original_method: The original SST storage method and full front-bay scope remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved storage harness only after physical-to-logical mapping, mount/swap/LVM/RAID checks and an exact I/O range interlock.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact front-side storage topology at cold undervoltage.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform storage map, approved tool documentation and lab environmental SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds protected-use, dew-point and integrity controls without replacing SST.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Every required bay and approved duration remain in scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Target map/ownership, workload/range, thresholds and fixture limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-target writes and condensation can cause irreversible harm.

missing_inputs: Complete bay disposition and stable mapping
Approved workload, I/O range and integrity method
safety_boundaries: No OS, mounted/in-use, RAID-member, data, evidence or unknown target
No moisture exposure, log clearing or unapproved destructive I/O
expected_evidence: Physical/logical bay mapping and pre-I/O interlocks
Full approved per-target workload and integrity evidence
no_automatic_retry: No replacement I/O cycle after failure.
engineer_owned_verdict: Storage/margin engineer owns the formal judgment.
review_improvement: Removes the planning-time conflict but preserves the genuine lack of acceptance and every storage/environmental safety boundary.
